tfrecord_protocol.scope: Strict whole-file preflight before EventAccumulator; CPU protocol fixtures may call this explicit function with the actual installed CRC updater after review
framing: length bytes of payload, read in <=1048576-byte chunks with incremental CRC32C
tfrecord_protocol.file_identity: Every consumed original byte also feeds SHA256; complete count/SHA equals inputeventfp, stat dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime before-after stable
tfrecord_protocol.failure: Any truncation, CRC mismatch, bound violation, incomplete EOF, I/O error or file identity change yields failed with byte offset/record index/record start; this event is not passed to EA. No early good prefix accepted.
tfrecord_protocol.implementation: Reuse tensorboard.compat.tensorflow_stub.pywrap_tensorflow.crc_update only after CPU Docker guard; standard uint32 mask is explicit in this source, no extra dependency.
